author: claude
description: Free accounts can currently store unlimited data. This adds a per-user storage quota (5 GiB default, overridable per plan through `quotaBytes`). `upload()` rejects files that would take the user over their quota with a `QuotaExceededError` carrying the used and allowed bytes, and a new `storage()` method returns usage for the settings page. Usage is measured from the bucket so it matches what we are billed for. The check is a soft limit: two simultaneous uploads can overshoot slightly, which product has signed off on. Tests cover rejection, per-user isolation, and space freed by deletes.

defects.mechanism: usedBytes lists the user's whole prefix and then issues a billed `head` per object, on every upload. A user with N files pays N+1 storage requests per upload, even though FileIndex already has every file's size and is written alongside each blob.

Uploading an existing name replaces the file, but the check adds the new size to usage that still includes the file being replaced. A user near quota cannot overwrite a file with a slightly larger version even though usage after the write would be under quota.
